parsing_traps.detail: Pages 100-102 show RMB'000 and S$'000 side by side for each property. They represent the SAME valuation in two currencies — do not add them. SGD column used as canonical (consolidated audited).

The face of Statement of Total Return (p95) shows Manager's management fees as a single line $17,613k. Note 20 (p148) splits this into base fee $10.3m and performance fee $7.3m. Income_components captures both sub-lines; total matches face.

Property shows zero valuation in 2025 Portfolio Statement (divested 31 Oct 2025). Partial-year P&L ($4,027k GR / $2,531k NPI from page 27) included in properties.json with status=divested and market_valuation=null.

Page 31 shows three sub-sector blocks (Retail 69.3%, Business Parks 27.0%, Logistics 3.7%) and leaf-level categories within each. Leaf-level categories captured in trade_mix.json. The three sub-sector totals are NOT captured as additional rows to avoid double-counting.

Portfolio Statement reports Ascendas Xinsu at 100% value (consolidated per SFRS). The 49% NCI share is deducted in the net assets reconciliation. market_valuation in properties.json = 100% consolidated figure as shown in Portfolio Statement.
